```{r}
library(ggplot2)

menSkating <- read_csv(here::here("frhinehart/Olympic Figure Skating/Module/MensFigureSkating.csv")) 


ggplot(data = menSkating, aes(x = SP, y = FS, color = factor(Year), group = Year)) +
 geom_point() +
 geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
 scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(title = "Figure Skating Scatterplot",
       x = "Short Program",
       y = "Free Skate")

menSkating2018 <- menSkating |> filter(Year == 2018)
menSkating20142022 <- menSkating |> filter(Year >= 2014)

ggplot(data = menSkating2018, aes(x = SP, y = FS)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  labs(title = "Figure Skating 2018 Scatterplot",
       x = "Short Program",
       y = "Free Skate")

ggplot(data = menSkating, aes(x = Year, y = TP, group = Year)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Figure Skating Boxplot",
       x = "Year",
       y = "Total Points")

ggplot(data = menSkating20142022, aes(x = SP, y = FS, color = factor(Year), group = Year)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(title = "Figure Skating 2014 -2022 Scatterplot",
       x = "Short Program",
       y = "Free Skate")
  
```
